title: Agreement at a specified cell
statement: Let $K:\mathbb{N}\to\mathrm{Prop}$ be a predicate and let $\mu,\mu':\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$ agree at every index satisfying $K$. If $\mu$ and $\mu'$ agree at exactly the index $b$, then $\mu'(b)=\mu(b)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mu$ and $\mu'$ agree at every index satisfying the predicate that the index equals $b$
